sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls sits in Niagara Falls, New York, on a multi-building campus on Frontier Avenue. The facility was approved in 2026 to reopen a site previously used for bitcoin mining. New York has 31 mapped data center facilities of which only one has published its power capacity publicly, and this campus ranks second in the state by announced megawatts, though no power specification is published for this site itself.

Since no IT power rating, total facility power, or PUE are published, the campus's capacity for AI workloads cannot be estimated from available data. The most recent source dates to 2026 and refers to bitcoin mining approval, not AI infrastructure deployment. Whether this facility has been repurposed for large-scale compute, operates as a mixed-use site, or remains in transition cannot be determined from published specifications.

The facility's relevance to AI scaling depends on information not yet disclosed: total power draw, cooling capacity, and actual current use. Without these figures, it cannot be ranked against other data center campuses or assessed as a factor in regional or national AI infrastructure constraints.
